description: This file defines functions for converting JSON strings into CMake strings by handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON-encoded string into a CMake string by removing quotation marks and handling escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a reference to a JSON string into a CMake string by dereferencing and processing through json_string_to_cmake.
